vacancyList.postName: Foreman of Stores (General Central Service, Group 'B', Non-Gazetted, Non-ministerial)

howToApply: Download the application form from the prescribed format given at Annexure-I in the official notification.
Fill the application form in English or Hindi as per the prescribed format.
Affix a self-attested colour passport size photograph on the application form.

Attach self-attested photocopies of the following documents: Aadhaar card, Matriculation/equivalent mark sheet and certificate, UG/PG/Diploma mark sheet and certificate, Latest Category Certificate (ST/EWS) if applicable, Experience Certificate, NOC from employer (if applicable), and two latest passport size colour photographs.
Enclose a separate blank envelope with Rs. 50/- postal stamp pasted on it, addressed to yourself.
Super-scribe the envelope in BOLD letters: ‘APPLICATION FOR THE POST OF FOREMAN OF STORES’ along with the category applied for.

Send the duly filled application with all attachments by ordinary post only to: The Director General, {For PD (Rectt)}, Coast Guard Headquarters, Directorate of Recruitment, C-1, Phase II, Industrial Area, Sector-62, Noida, U.P. – 201309.
The application must reach by 03 Nov 2026. Applications sent by hand or courier will not be accepted.

howToApply: Visit the official website of OPSC at http://opsc.gov.in.
Go through the details of the Advertisement before filling up the online application form.
Register and fill the Online Application Form available on the OPSC website from 09.09.2026 to 09.10.2026 (5.00 P.M.).
Upload scanned image of latest passport size photograph, full signature, and Left-Hand Thumb Impression (LTI) in the Online Application Form.
Pay the examination fee of Rs. 700/- (for candidates other than SC/ST) through online mode (Credit Card, Debit Card, UPI, Net Banking, Wallet, etc.).
Furnish bank account details (Account Number, IFSC Code, Name of Account Holder, Name of Bank Branch) in the required field for refund purposes.
Submit the Online Application Form before the closing date of 09.10.2026 (5.00 P.M.).
On successful submission, a unique Permanent Public Service Account Number (PPSAN) will be assigned. Take a printout of the finally submitted online application form.
Applications received through any other mode will not be accepted and will be summarily rejected.
For technical issues, contact OPSC Technical Support at 0671-2304707 between 10.30 A.M. to 1.30 P.M. & 2.00 P.M. to 5.30 P.M. on Odisha Government working days.
